description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maligathenna, Kandy Four Gravets & Gangawata Koralaya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 320290
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed descriptions of land locations, parcel numbers, cadastral maps, ownership details, and property rights. The content focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
